variable.Name: CIVIL_CIVILCELLS_DGNLIB_FILE
variable.LongDescription: 1. This variable defines both the directory and specific file name of the Civil Cells DGN Library. Example: CIVIL_CIVILCELLS_DGNLIB_FILE = c:\workspace\dgnlibs\civilcells.dgnlib 2. This variable should allow the use of wildcards. Example: CIVIL_CIVILCELLS_DGNLIB_FILE = c:\workspace\dgnlibs\*.dgnlib 3. If this variable is NOT set or the dgnlib file is not found then the process should just work as it does today (i.e. just look inside each dgnlib and list any that contain civil cells). 4. If this variable IS set and the file is found then this file should be used to list the civil cells and for nothing further. In other words if this file contains other civil items (such as feature definitions or project settings or filters) they should be ignored.

variable.Name: CIVIL_DEFAULT_CURVE_STROKING
variable.LongDescription: Defines how often to compute a point or template drop interval location along a curve segment with extra points being computed based on the chord offset from the horizontal curve. The value defines the chord height used to calculate the extra points. If not set, the value defaults to 0.01. This is used in Corridor Modeling when Horizontal Curve Densification is applied.

variable.Name: CIVIL_DEFAULT_LINEAR_STROKING
variable.LongDescription: Defines how often to compute a point or template drop interval location on a tangent segment.This variable is not used by Corridor Modeling. If not set, the value defaults to 10. This is used when generating 3d elements and the apply Template command.

variable.Name: CIVIL_DEFAULT_PROFILE_STROKING
variable.LongDescription: Defines how often to compute a point or template drop interval location along a profile, with extra points being computed based on a chord offset from the profile. The value defines the chord height used to calculate the extra points. If not set, the value defaults to 0.1. This is used in Corridor Modeling when Vertical Curve Densification is applied.

variable.Name: CIVIL_DEFAULT_STATION_LOCK
variable.LongDescription: If set to 'true' then stations for various commands are calculated and kept at even numbers. For example, template drops would always fall on even stations in the event of an equation that could cause it to do otherwise. If not set or set to 'false', then the station values will be maintained at the specified increments.

variable.Name: CIVIL_DEFAULTSETTINGS

variable.Name: CIVIL_DESIGNSTANDARDSDGNLIBLIST

variable.Name: CIVIL_DISALLOW_LOCKCHANGES
variable.LongDescription: If set to a value of 1, it disallows any lock changes to existing rules. In other words, it prevents a locked rule from being unlocked or an unlocked rule from being locked.

variable.Name: CIVIL_DISALLOW_REFERENCEDELETIONS
variable.LongDescription: If set to a value of 1, it does not allow an element to be deleted if that element is referenced by another. Does not work across reference files.

variable.Name: CIVIL_PRODUCT_ACTIVE
variable.LongDescription: MicroStation Configuration Variable that specifies which Civil software (InRoads or GEOPAK) will interact with the Civil Geometry tools. Installation of InRoads automatically sets this variable equal to InRoads. To have GEOPAK interact with the Civil Geometry tools, overwrite the InRoads value with a new value of GEOPAK. Exit and restart MicroStation for this setting to take effect.

variable.Name: CIVIL_REPORTS_DIRECTORY
variable.LongDescription: If the variable is set to a valid directory location, then the software would look at this specific location to locate the XML reports. If this variable is NOT set or it's set to an invalid location, then the software would look at the location where Civil installs the reports by default. NOTE: If the InRoads Project Default XSL location is defined then that is used before CIVIL_REPORTS_DIRECTORY. This maintains continuity for InRoads users.

variable.Name: CIVIL_ROADWAY_TEMPLATE_LIBRARY

variable.Name: CIVIL_SHOW_MS_PROPERTIES

variable.LongDescription: If this variable is set to 1, then any attributes associated with a point during the import process will be written to the point�s DESCRIPTION field as well as the attribute field. By populating the DESCRIPTION field, the data can be annotated graphically as the DESCRIPTION. The ATTRIBUTE field cannot be annotated.

variable.Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_DISABLE_DIVIDE_BY_TWELVE
variable.LongDescription: If set to a value of 1, this variable indicates that the sizes read from a GEOPAK SMD XML file should not be divided by 12 when linked into Survey Feature Definitions. (Applicable for GEOPAK XML SMD files in an English environment only)

variable.Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_ELEVATION_POSITION_FIVE_ANGLE

variable.Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_GEOID_BINFILE_FOLDER

variable.Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_STYLEFILE_FILE

variable.Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_SURVEYOPTIONS_NAME
variable.LongDescription: As the XIN can contain multiple instances of Survey Options, this allows the definition of a particular Survey Options to apply when reading the XIN file. If this variable is not defined, then the LAST occurence of the Survey Options is used. (InRoads only)

variable.Name: CIVIL_SURVEY_USERTIW_FOLDER

variable.Name: CIVIL_XIN_FILE

variable.Name: DA_DISABLE_DIVIDE_BY_TWELVE.
variable.LongDescription: Ability to disable dividing by twelve when using Annotation Scale. This will accommodate ratios for annotation scales. (e.g. 1:100)

variable.Name: DTM_BSPLINE_SMOOTHING_FACTOR
variable.LongDescription: When contour smoothing option is set to Bspline this factor controls the degree of smoothing. The value ranges from 0.0 to 5.0. If it is outside of these limits then it is set to either the bottom range or top range. Therefore when set to 6 then the program will use 5. If set to -1 then the program will use 0. A smoothing factor of zero will force the spline to honor all contour vertices. An increase to the smoothing factor moves away from contour vertices. If a contour vertex is a tin point or on a break line, the smoothing factor for that vertex is set to 0.0.

variable.Name: GPK_ACBOOK_DDBFILE
variable.LongDescription: Denotes the default DDB file as well as the default directory for DDB files. When initially invoking the Design & Computation Manager, this DDB file appears in the Path dialog. Moreover, when selecting File > Open, the directory tree is set where this DDB file resides, even if another DDB file from another directory is the current DDB. Not setting this configuration variable would cause Design & Computation Manager to initially look for ..\GEOPAK\bin\default.ddb. Subsequent searches would start in the same directory as the current DDB file.

variable.Name: GPK_ACBOOK_DDBFILE_STYLES
variable.LongDescription: This variable sets the DDB file that defines the styles available in Corridor Modeling. Corridor Modeling imports the drafting standards from the selected DDB file into a .xin file. If this variable is not set, the software uses a default DDB file.

variable.Name: GPK_ACBOOK_ITEM_HELP_INDEX_FILE

variable.Name: GPK_ACBOOK_ITEM_HELP_URL_TEMPLATE

variable.Name: GPK_ACBOOK_POBPOELABEL
variable.LongDescription: Provides the option of additional information being included in conjunction with the Point on Tangent (POT) labels - displayed at the beginning and end of alignments. The following information is included with the Point on Tangent (POT): Point of Beginning (POB) Point of End (POE) The option is activated once the variable is set, using only the value = 1, then the software will produce labels containing the additional options listed above.

variable.Name: GPK_ACBOOK_XINFILE_STYLES
variable.LongDescription: This variable points to a global .xin file on a server. When this variable is set and the .xin file it points to exists, the Import DDB option is disabled.

variable.Name: GPK_ACCUSNAP_IDENTIFY_ELEMENTS_AUTOMATICALLY
variable.LongDescription: Set to a value of 0, MicroStation element attribute is displayed and the GEOPAK attribute is NOT displayed. If set to 1, both the MicroStation and GEOPAK attributes are displayed.

variable.Name: GPK_BOREHOLE_GTPFILE

variable.Name: GPK_COGO_EXPORT_PREFERENCE_FILE

variable.Name: GPK_COMPUTATION_ENGLISH_UNIT_DEF_FILE

variable.Name: GPK_COMPUTATION_GRAPHIC_TABULATION_PREFERENCE_FILE
variable.LongDescription: Denotes the default .qtd settings file that is utilized to configure the type of table and content for the quantity computation results, when selecting the export format option "Table" from the Computation Result dialog.

variable.Name: GPK_COMPUTATION_USE_MINIMUM_MAXIMUM_OFFSETS
variable.LongDescription: When computing with D&C Manager for a linear element or a shape, GEOPAK computes the min and max station point. This information is then exported to QM. In QM it shows Minimum Station, Minimum Offset, Maximum Station, and Maximum Offset. Minimum and maximum offsets means "offset of the minimum station point" and "offset of the maximum station point". If this variable is set and its value = 1, then the software exports the true minimum and maximum offsets.

variable.Name: GPK_COMPUTATON_CSV_REPORT_PREFERENCE_FILE

variable.Name: GPK_DDB_STA_LARGE_TICKS

variable.Name: GPK_DISABLE_PW_SHEET_CHECKIN

variable.Name: GPK_DISABLE_PW_TITLEBLOCKS

variable.Name: GPK_DRGPREF_DEFCELLLIB

variable.Name: GPK_DRGPREF_DEFDRLIB

variable.Name: GPK_DTM_VALIDATE_POLYGONAL_FEATURES

variable.Name: GPK_EDITOR

variable.Name: GPK_FORCE_ALLCFGVARS

variable.Name: GPK_FORCE_SURVMNGR_SMDFILE

These variables have the keyword _FORCE_ inserted into the generic variables. If this is defined then the variable is always used to define the file and or directory used. Without this forcing, the resource file has priority. Note: Not all GEOPAK variables have a force variable. See the GEOPAK Help for a list of those variables that can be forced. The syntax to set and then force the variable is illustrated left. Note the variable is set first, and then the force option is a second line. GPK_FORCE_SURVMNGR_SMDFILE = 1

variable.Name: GPK_GEOTECH_FILETYPE

Not setting this configuration variable would result in Project Manager looking for criteria files in the working directory. variable.Name: GPK_PROFILE_COMPUTATION

variable.Name: GPK_PROJECTWISE_MESSAGEPOPUP

variable.Name: GPK_PROJMGR_PROJECTDIR

variable.Name: GPK_QUANTITYMANAGER_CFGFILE
variable.LongDescription: Defines a specific Quantity Manager configuration file (.cfg), and ignores the local default version. Utilize when the Quantity Manager works from a file that is not local, for example a file that is located on a central server. The location of this file must be listed using a mapped network drive, as the configuration file does not support conventional file path format.

variable.Name: GPK_RD_NO_DISPLAY_FEATURES
variable.LongDescription: When this is set to 1, it will turn off drawing of roadway designer plan view features. This will enhance the speed of processing within Roadway Designer on larger projects.

variable.Name: GPK_RD_TEMPLATE_LIBRARY
variable.LongDescription: This variable sets the default template library to be used in Corridor Modeling.

variable.Name: GPK_RSCDIR
variable.LongDescription: Defines the location of the GEOPAK resource files.

variable.Name: GPK_SHEET_TYPE_OPTIONS

variable.Name: GPK_SHEET_TYPE_OPTIONS_LOCK
variable.LongDescription: When set to 1, the Sheet_Type_Options shown in the sheet applications are locked so the user cannot create a Custom defined sheet type.

variable.Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_IGNORE_MISSING_REFS

variable.Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SEED_PROFILE_MOTIF_FILE_NAME
variable.LongDescription: References the motif seed file name for profile view

variable.Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SEED_TABULAR_DATA_MOTIF_FILE_DIR
variable.LongDescription: Defines the location of the tabular data motif seed file directory

variable.Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SEED_TABULAR_DATA_MOTIF_FILE_NAME
variable.LongDescription: References the motif seed file name for tabular data view

variable.Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SHEET_CELL_LIBRARY_DIR
variable.LongDescription: Contains the path in which to search for sheet cell libraries (which are named in the currently attached sheet library) if the entry does not contain a path. If this variable is not defined, cell libraries for sheets are first searched for in the current directory, then in the GEOPAK bin folder.

variable.Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SHEET_LIBRARY_DIR
variable.LongDescription: This is the path to be used for determining the path of the sheet library as set out in the _DIR Variables section above. Its corresponding dialog items are the Sheet > Library > Attach file selector dialog in the sheet clip application. In the sheet library application, it influences the file selector dialogs for Library > New, Library > Save As, Library > Open if those paths are not already set.

variable.Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SHEET_LIBRARY_NAME
variable.LongDescription: Path and name for the sheet library. If GPK_SHEETCLP_SHEET_LIBRARY_NAME is not set, the application opens with default.psl located in the GEOPAK bin folder.

variable.Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_SHEET_OUTPUT_DIR
variable.LongDescription: This is the directory with which to initialize the Output Directory in the Clip Sheets dialog. If the variable is not defined, the current working directory is utilized.

variable.Name: GPK_SHEETCLP_TABULAR_DATA_MOTIF_FILE_DIR
variable.LongDescription: Sets the Motif File for the corresponding Tabular Port Information dialog. In addition. When not defined, the current working directory is utilized.

variable.Name: GPK_SUPER_AUTOSHAPEINPUTDIR
variable.LongDescription: Directory to write autoshape input files and log files. Not setting this configuration variable would cause the tool to initially look in the user's current directory.

variable.Name: GPK_SUPER_EDIR
variable.LongDescription: Directory to search for e-computation csv files. Not setting this configuration variable would cause the tool to initially look in ..\GEOPAK\bin\ bin directory.

variable.Name: GPK_SUPER_EDITOR
variable.LongDescription: Application to use in editing .csv files from the Preference Dialog. There is no default if the variable is not defined. Include the entire path and executable file name.

variable.Name: GPK_SUPER_LENGTHDIR
variable.LongDescription: Directory to search for length-computation csv files. Not setting this configuration variable would cause the tool to initially look in ..\GEOPAK\bin\ bin directory.

variable.Name: GPK_SUPER_PREFDIR
variable.LongDescription: Directory to search for Preferences Files GEOPAK bin directory Not setting this configuration variable would cause the tool to initially look in ..\GEOPAK\bin\ bin directory.

variable.Name: GPK_SURVEY_DISABLEGEODOUTPUT
variable.LongDescription: If this variable is enabled it disables the output screen when processing large data files in order to decrease the delay in processing.

variable.Name: GPK_SURVEY_EXTERNALOBSCONVERTEREXE
variable.LongDescription: This variable allows the user to specify an external OBS converter.

variable.Name: GPK_SURVEY_EXTERNALOBSPARAMS
variable.LongDescription: Parameters to send to the converter exe. %o = Full path to obs file (path only) %g = Full file path and extension of obs to be created or appended to %m = Base name of obs file no extension %p = Full path to raw file (path only) %f = Full file path and extension of raw %n = Base name of raw file no extension %w = 0 for Overwrite, 1 for Append

variable.Name: GPK_SURVEY_LEICADBXDIR
variable.LongDescription: Defines the full path to the Leica Job Directory when using Leica DBX.

variable.Name: GPK_SURVEY_SCANGPKFORORPHANRUNS
variable.LongDescription: Set to 1 on data set open or new if the gpk has any datasets names in it that is not part of current project. It will create a dataset record for the dataset. If set to 0, it will not look for them.

variable.Name: GPK_SURVEY_SEED_DGNFILE
variable.LongDescription: This variable, when set to a full path and seed design file, displays a new test field and icon in the ASCII import dialog to specify an existing or new file name to draw graphics to.

variable.Name: GPK_SURVEY_SEED_SDPFILE
variable.LongDescription: Sets the default settings initially for survey on startup and should include full path, file name and extension. GPK_SURVEY_SEED_SDPFILE = d:/temp/$(units)/def.sdp

variable.Name: GPK_SURVMNGR_SMDFILE
variable.LongDescription: Denotes the default SMD file as well as the default directory for SMD files. When initially invoking the Survey Manager, this SMD file appears in the Path dialog. Moreover, when selecting File > Open, the directory tree is set where this SMD file resides, even if another SMD file from another directory is the current SMD. Not setting this configuration variable would cause Survey Manager to initially look for ...\GEOPAK\bin\default.smd. Subsequent searches would start in the same directory as the current SMD file.

variable.Name: GPK_TABLES_RTRFILE
variable.LongDescription: Denotes the location and name of the default tables file. When the variable is not utilized, GEOPAK uses tables.rtr located in the GEOPAK \bin directory.

variable.Name: GPK_TXDOT_SUPER_PARABOLIC_TRANSITION
variable.LongDescription: If set to 1, this variable enables the Texas DOT super elevation non-linear curve option. This option is used to center the parabolic curve length on the transition.

variable.Name: GPK_TYPICAL
variable.LongDescription: Denotes the default directory where typicals files reside. When not set, GEOPAK looks in ..\GEOPAK\samples\road\typical directory.

variable.Name: GPK_TYPICAL_CRITERIA_OUTPUT_DIR
variable.LongDescription: Denotes the directory destination for generated typical section criteria files and any INCLUDE and GET commands utilized within the criteria control file.

variable.Name: GPK_TYPICAL_EDITOR
variable.LongDescription: Setting this variable invokes a different text editor. By default, GEOPAK opens WordPad to view typical description files. If the typical documentation files were created with a different editing or word processing software, it is prudent to review the files utilizing the same software. Include the entire path and executable file name.

variable.Name: GPK_TYPICAL_HELPFILE_EXTENSION
variable.LongDescription: Specifies the default extension of the Typical Section Generator help files. If this is not set then the default extension is .wri.

variable.Name: GPK_TYPICAL_SUPPRESS_CRITERIA_FILE_OVERWRITE_PROMPT
variable.LongDescription: If this variable is enabled then the Typical Section Generator prompt of whether or not to overwrite criteria files is suppressed. GPK_TYPICAL_SUPPRESS_CRITERIA_FILE_OVERWRITE_PROMPT = 1

variable.Name: GPK_XS_SHEET_LIBRARY_DIR

In the sheet library application, it influences the file selector dialogs for Library > New, Library > Save As, Library > Open if those paths are not already set. If the user specifies GPK_XS_SHEET_LIBRARY_NAME and that file has no path in it, the applications search for _NAME in the directory _DIR. If it does not find it, it looks next in the current directory then in the ..\GEOPAK\bin directory.

variable.Name: GPK_XS_SHEET_LIBRARY_NAME
variable.LongDescription: The sheet library name and path. If not set, the application opens with default.xssl (located in .GEOPAK\bin).

variable.Name: GPK_XS_SHEET_MODEL_PREFIX
variable.LongDescription: Specifies a prefix to be used when the option is selected to place xs sheets in individual models.

variable.Name: GPKDRG_HYD_METHOD
variable.LongDescription: 0 (Mannings) 1 (Hazen-Williams) 2 (Colebrook White)

variable.Name: GPKDRG_SMOOTH_HGL
